faqAuthQ: Do I need permission to scan?
faqAuthA: Only scan hosts and apps you own or are authorized to test. Unauthorized scanning is not allowed.
faqPentestA: No. Sinexis is scheduled scanning, reports, and a thin Guard layer. It does not replace an annual pentest engagement.
faqDataA: Results live in your workspace. See the privacy policy on this site; do not upload secrets you cannot store.
faqGuardA: Guard is inventory + critical alerts (Wazuh thin). Full SIEM search is optional and off by default.
faqAgentA: No. One wazuh-agent per VM. Host Protect is a helper add-on, not a second enroll daemon.
